title: Synthetic EGD and two-lesion colonoscopy

document.text:
SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
Procedure report
Date of service: 2026-10-21
Place of service: hospital outpatient endoscopy unit
Procedures: EGD with biopsy; colonoscopy with biopsy and snare polypectomy.
EGD: The endoscope was advanced to the second portion of the duodenum. Cold forceps biopsies were taken from the gastric antrum.
Colonoscopy: The colonoscope was advanced to the cecum; the appendiceal orifice was identified.
Lesion A - ascending colon: a 3 mm sessile polyp was removed with cold biopsy forceps.
Lesion B - sigmoid colon: a 9 mm sessile polyp was removed with a cold snare. A clip was placed to prevent bleeding.
Plan: Repeat colonoscopy in 3 years.
